columns.description: System-generated unique code identifying the asset
Asset name from the Asset Register (display only)
Capitalization date from the Asset Register (display only); installation date cannot be earlier than this
Optional parent asset this record is a child/component of; links to another row in this same Asset Register

Whether this record is a depreciable Fixed Asset or a non-depreciable Other Asset. Editable only until the record is first saved (see the Asset Code item_change protect rule); once saved it is permanently locked — an asset must never be reclassified after creation.
Asset category, used to default useful life, depreciation method and residual value
Lifecycle status of the asset record
Date the asset was disposed (sale/scrap); set automatically when the linked Asset Disposal record is approved
Date the asset was last physically verified; set automatically when a Conduct Physical Verification cycle covering this asset is approved
Manufacturer serial number; must be unique within the asset's category
Manufacturer/brand of the asset
Model number/name of the asset
Free text description of the asset
Photo of the asset
Generated QR code / barcode tag value identifying this asset (use the Generate QR/Barcode Tag action)
Branch where the asset is located
Physical location (building/floor/room/site) within the branch
Department/cost centre the asset belongs to
Employee currently in custody of the asset
Free text vendor/supplier name; not validated against a master
Vendor invoice number for the purchase
Date the asset was purchased
Base purchase cost of the asset
Freight, installation, duties and other costs capitalized with the asset
Computed as Purchase Cost + Other Capitalized Cost
Useful life in years under the Companies Act; defaulted from the asset's category and editable. Required for Fixed Asset records; not applicable (leave blank) for Other Asset records.
Depreciation method under the Companies Act; defaulted from the asset's category and editable. Required for Fixed Asset records; not applicable (leave blank) for Other Asset records.
Residual value percentage defaulted from the asset's category; used to compute Residual Value
Computed as Total Capitalized Cost x Residual Value %

Written-down value of this asset under the Companies Act as on the date in Opening WDV As On Date, for a pre-existing/legacy asset being onboarded into this depreciation regime. Leave blank for a fresh asset with no prior Companies Act depreciation history. Opening Accumulated Depreciation below is derived automatically from this value.
Accumulated depreciation as on the Opening WDV As On Date, computed automatically as Total Capitalized Cost minus Opening WDV. Read-only.

Date as of which Opening Accumulated Depreciation is stated for a legacy asset that existed before this system went live (typically a financial-year-end, e.g. 31-Mar). The Companies Act monthly depreciation process uses this date + Opening Accumulated Depreciation as the asset's starting WDV baseline for the first month it processes after this date; leave blank for assets that were capitalized and depreciated for the first time within this system.

System-computed total accumulated depreciation for Companies Act reporting = Opening Accumulated Depreciation + depreciation accumulated by the system's Companies Act SLM/WDV formula from Capitalization Date up to today (or up to disposal, capped so the asset never depreciates below its Companies Act Residual Value).
Income Tax block-of-assets code; defaulted from the asset's category and editable

Written-down value of this asset under the Income Tax Act as on the date in Income Tax Opening WDV As On Date, for a pre-existing/legacy asset being onboarded into Income Tax block depreciation. Leave blank for a fresh asset with no prior Income Tax depreciation history. This is independent of the Companies Act Opening WDV above — the two regimes compute depreciation separately.

Date (typically a financial-year-end, e.g. 31-Mar) as of which Income Tax Opening WDV is stated for a legacy asset that existed before this system went live. Leave blank for assets first capitalized within this system.
Start date of the manufacturer/vendor warranty
End date of the manufacturer/vendor warranty
Whether an Annual Maintenance Contract currently covers this asset
Free text remarks about the asset
Internal surrogate identifier
Date/time the record was created
User who created the record
Terminal/IP from which the record was created
Date/time the record was last changed
User who last changed the record
Terminal/IP from which the record was last changed
